description: Shared configuration of the Section 6 experiments (pure-longitudinal screened kernel). Read through sec6_config.py; do not hard-code these values in scripts.

model.kernel: K_kappa(r) = exp(-kappa r)/r * r r^T / r^2 (pure longitudinal, screened)
model.periodic: full periodic lattice sum, k = 0 retained, no minimum image
model.not_this_model: Lennard-Jones application parameters (lj075_*, toy_*: kernel amplitude, kappa, density, dt = 0.005) must not be mixed in

spatial_sets_note: Accepted in test_equal_accuracy_xi.py on cases A and B only (equal_accuracy_xi_results/accepted_best.csv). Their measured scope after Experiment 1 is in exp1_results/parameter_set_status.json; the nominal tolerance is NOT a guarantee for other configurations.

production.dt_source: dynamics_results/params_small.json: dt = 0.2 m / median lambda_max(q0) over the 16 initial N = 64 ideal-gas configurations; the same physical dt is used at every N
production.ranks_source: set by the Lanczos rank-selection stage (sec6_results/lanczos/rank_selection.json); null until that stage has run

lanczos.start: direct start q1 = Pi v / ||Pi v||
lanczos.reorthogonalisation: full, two Gram-Schmidt passes per step
lanczos.projection: Pi = (I_N - 11^T/N) kron I_3 after every Gamma_h action
lanczos.centre_of_mass_momentum: copied exactly (p_new = p_mean + R Pi p + S Pi xi)

budgets.reference_margin_note: a reference is accepted for a tolerance tol only if its non-adjacent self-differences (S vs S-20, S-40) are <= reference_margin * tol
